name: GET /api/fda/flags/:kNumber - recall and MAUDE flags
description: Recall and adverse-event flags for a K-number. recalls: every FDA device recall whose record names this K-number (total, open = status 'Open, Classified', up to 20 most recent with status, dates, firm, reason and FDA link). maude: adverse-event report counts, which FDA publishes per product code not per K-number (scope 'product_code'); tracked=false with null counts when our copy does not track that code, so absence is never shown as zero events. Each block has its own as-of date. Covers: recall and MAUDE flags are returned for a K-number. Needs the FDA copy loaded (npm run fda:bulk -- classification 510k recall; npm run fda:sync -- event_counts); test values are real FDA records: K031698 (Roche, cleared 2003-08-20), product code FRN (infusion pump, class 2, 21 CFR 880.5725), K251636 (FRN, named in recall Z-1368-2026). Since the F1.5 cutover (ADR-017) the app answers from the fda-data service through @medexregai/fda-sdk; the local run needs that service up (cd services/fda-data && npm run dev:local).

errorCases.when: kNumber does not match the FDA format

errorCases.message: not in our copy of the FDA data
errorCases.when: well-formed kNumber that the FDA copy does not hold

errorCases.message: FDA data is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errorCases.when: the fda-data service is down or rejects the app key (and the answer is not cached)
errorCases.reason: Needs the fda-data service stopped during the run; verified by hand on 2026-11-10 (meta, flags and 510(k) returned 503 FDA_UNAVAILABLE).
